item.title: Benchmark rate unchanged at 6.25 per cent, committee splits five to one
item.description: The rate decision keeps borrowing costs at 6.25 per cent. Economists at two brokerages disputed the growth projection of 6.8 per cent cited by the committee.

item.title: Trade pact talks with Verland resume after eight months
item.description: Negotiators resumed talks on a trade agreement with Verland in Geneva. The commerce ministry said tariff lines covering 4,200 products are under discussion.
